title: Localized derived tensor comparison under compatible ring isomorphisms
statement: Let $R,A,B,D,R_0,A_0,B_0,D_0$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $A,B$, an $(A\otimes_R B)$-algebra structure on $D$, and corresponding structures at subscript $0$. Fix derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of $R,B,R_0,B_0$-modules. Let $e_R,e_A,e_B,e_D$ be ring isomorphisms satisfying $e_A(ra)=e_R(r)e_A(a)$, $e_B(rb)=e_R(r)e_B(b)$ on the structural ring maps, and $e_D(\mu(a\otimes b))=\mu_0(e_A(a)\otimes e_B(b))$, where $\mu,\mu_0$ are the tensor-algebra maps to $D,D_0$. Let $Q,Q_0$ be complexes of $A,A_0$-modules and $q:Q\cong\operatorname{Res}_{e_A}Q_0$ a chain isomorphism. Let $M,M_0$ be base-derived tensor cohomology models [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] for these inputs. Write $V=D\otimes_A Q$, $V_0=D_0\otimes_{A_0}Q_0$ termwise, with the composite structural maps. Suppose $t:V\cong\operatorname{Res}_{e_D}V_0$ is a chain isomorphism with $t^k(d\otimes x)=e_D(d)\otimes q^k(x)$. For every $i\in\mathbf Z$, put $T=\operatorname{Res}_{e_D}$ and $c_i:H^i(TV_0)\cong T(H^i(V_0))$ for exact restriction of scalars. Let $F,F_0$ forget scalars to additive groups. There exists an additive isomorphism $l:F(D\otimes_{A\otimes_R B}M^i)\cong F_0(D_0\otimes_{A_0\otimes_{R_0}B_0}M_0^i)$ such that $l;F_0(b_0);F(c_i^{-1})=F(b);F(H^i(t))$, where $b,b_0$ are the models' localized comparisons. Neither $b$ nor $b_0$ is assumed invertible.

proof.text: Evaluate hD at (a,1) and (1,b) to obtain compatibility of the coefficient maps A to D and B to D. Express hA and hB as equalities of ring homomorphisms. Forget q and t to additive chain isomorphisms; q linearity gives the required semilinearity and ht gives the target generator formula. Apply the existing localized ring transport theorem to obtain l and its additive-homology square.

Compare left homology data mapped by restriction followed by forgetting with the same data mapped by direct forgetting. Identity maps on cycles and homology satisfy the three compatibility equations, so homology-map naturality at the identity identifies their homology isomorphisms. The mapHomologyIso_eq formula and inverse cancellation give coherence of the exact homology comparisons.

Compose the ring-transport square with the inverse of the restriction homology comparison. Replace the composite direct-forgetful and restriction factors using the coherence identity. Apply Mathlib ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality to t and cancel the remaining forgetful homology isomorphism. This is the required square, without any assumption that a localized comparison is invertible.

theorem exists_baseDerivedTensor_ringIso_square
    {R A B D R0 A0 B0 D0 : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [CommRing R0] [CommRing A0] [CommRing B0] [CommRing D0]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) D]
    [Algebra R0 A0] [Algebra R0 B0] [Algebra (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R0)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B0)]
    (eR : R ≃+* R0) (eA : A ≃+* A0) (eB : B ≃+* B0) (eD : D ≃+* D0)
    (hA : ∀ r : R, eA (algebraMap R A r) = algebraMap R0 A0 (eR r))
    (hB : ∀ r : R, eB (algebraMap R B r) = algebraMap R0 B0 (eR r))
    (hD : ∀ (a : A) (b : B),
      eD (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D (a ⊗ₜ[R] b)) =
        algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0 (eA a ⊗ₜ[R0] eB b))
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (Q0 : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A0) ℤ)
    (q : Q ≅ ((restrictScalars.{u} eA.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q0)
    (M : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (M0 : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R0 A0 B0 Q0 D0)
    (t : (((extendScalars.{u, u, u} ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
        (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≅
      ((restrictScalars.{u} eD.toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars.{u, u, u} ((algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0).comp
          (algebraMap A0 (A0 ⊗[R0] B0)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q0))
    (ht : ∀ (k : ℤ) (d : D) (x : Q.X k),
      t.hom.f k (d ⊗ₜ[A, (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
        (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))] x) =
      eD d ⊗ₜ[A0, (algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0).comp
        (algebraMap A0 (A0 ⊗[R0] B0))] (show Q0.X k from q.hom.f k x))
    (i : ℤ) :
    let V0 := ((extendScalars.{u, u, u} ((algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0).comp
      (algebraMap A0 (A0 ⊗[R0] B0)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q0
    let T := restrictScalars.{u} eD.toRingHom
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} D) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} D0) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    ∃ l : F.obj ((extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj
        (M.cohomology i)) ≅
        F0.obj ((extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0)).obj
          (M0.cohomology i)),
      l.hom ≫ F0.map (M0.localizedComparison i) ≫
          F.map ((V0.sc i).mapHomologyIso T).inv =
        F.map (M.localizedComparison i) ≫
          F.map (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t.hom i)
